# Edward Armon Sieker

Edward Armon Sieker Jr. ( – 1901), sometimes styled Ed A. Sieker in print, was an American lawman who was a Texas Rangers, in which capacity he was involved in a number of gunfights with Native American and outlaws. His three brothers, including Lamartine Pemberton Sieker, all became Texas Rangers.
